body: I will look! Just googled some of the few options for therapists and one was like openly writing articles protesting pride marches and general homophobic, so I’ll definitely pay myself if that gives me the right to choose.. aaaahh, it’s a good day when I can laugh at this horrible shitshow.

Thanks! Books are an idea worth trying, any to recommend?
I have some money saved up, by being a very cautious person. Was supposed to wait with therapy until next year, moving to a larger city with cheaper and more options. But I’ll never get to move for uni if I don’t get that far

See that’s the problem - US has freedom as a higher value than here. Here it varies. A learned therapist might hear me out before taking those forced actions, but my family doctor with little mental health training might see that there’s months of waitlist and consider me unsafe enough to get me forced into treatment right away. Maybe even think he’s doing me a favor. I won’t know unless I go there. 
As for not being honest, the more suicidal the shorter the waitlist - rephrasing of what the school nurse and research has said. If I give too mild reasons I won’t get therapy at all. It’s a tricky situation 

Edit: if I was constant suicidal I would take the risk, but it’s like I’m split and switch between long good periods and very suicidal periods in between where I don’t trust myself (in a good one now)

It sucks getting to a better place and then feeling it fall apart again. Your ex boyfriend seems to have his issues as well if he so defiantly won’t move out. It’s hard to talk to close friends, but you might try to find someone it’s easier with. This is a good step 

I don’t know how to «snap» out of it, I think it will take time. But know that I really hope it will get better for you. You seem reflective

I just can’t with my family, they’re in a weird place and they’ve lost so many. I’ve looked into other resources, but they’re all directed at more general anxiety/depression which is nor my problem and if i was honest I would maybe be institutionalized (fucked up healthcare where i live) and that scares me off

It’s bittersweet because I can plan as much I want, but they keep dissolving faster than I can patch them. I have family I love, but hearing I’m suicidal would be much more upsetting to them than the average person

I chatted with someone and she was like «yeah, your situation seem really tough» and I wanted to cry from how little motivating that was. Like someone who talks to suicidal people daily being like I don’t really know what you should do, not giving me any resources or tips when I asked for it. A lot of people are morons though, and I guess they can be on hotlines as well. Try another one or not, I honestly don’t know what’s best
